Due to a regulatory restriction, a direct fiber link cannot be established between Node Alpha and Node Beta. Furthermore, due to a technical compatibility constraint, the final ring must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the connection between Node Beta and Node Gamma, or the connection between Node Gamma and Node Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total cable length required to construct a single, continuous ring that interconnects every node precisely once and returns to the origin node.
